full_judgment: 9. The learned Counsel for the petitioner next attempts to argue that the kabuliyat of jagabandhu Baruri having not been followed by a patta executed by Madaripur Pourasava the settlement of the disputed land in favour of Jagabandhu Baruri is violative of section 107 of the Transfer of Property Act. This question was not agitated before the High Court Division. Moreover, we see no substance in it on the facts and in the circumstances established in the case.
